accessible_snapshots.closest_mechanism: One-time global duplicate binary-feature preprocessing and task-specific feature eligibility in recursive search.
Lexical candidate matches were reviewed as false positives; no equality grouping of current-state response partitions was found.
Equivalent-point and support bounds plus symmetry-aware leaf caching.

unavailable_snapshot.status: not reproducibly obtained through the available Bitbucket transport

reviewed_conclusion: No implementation equivalent to descendant-specific response-partition quotienting was found in the four accessible pinned snapshots. The closest accessible mechanism was PySTreeD's one-time global duplicate-feature preprocessing. This is evidence of implementation distinctness in the audited snapshots, not proof of universal novelty.
claim_boundary: MurTree remains a disclosed source-level gap. Absence from the four accessible snapshots cannot establish a world-first or universal novelty claim.
